# Patch-authoring guidance for mercury-cli

When making changes to this fork, follow these five principles in priority order.

## 1. Use upstream's extensibility seams before patching core

Before modifying any existing file, check whether one of these extension points fits your use case:

- **`MERCURY_API_KEY` env var** — `pkg/cmd/cmd.go` reads this as a `requestflag.Flag[string]` with `Sources: cli.EnvVars("MERCURY_API_KEY")`. It takes precedence over OAuth tokens (see `pkg/cmd/auth.go` handleStatus). Use this for injecting API keys from the harness instead of patching auth.
- **`MERCURY_BASE_URL` env var** — `cmd/mercury/main.go` reads this to override the API base URL. Use this for pointing at internal proxies or mock servers without source changes.
- **`--environment` flag** — resolves to `production` or `sandbox`. Auth tokens and API base URLs are scoped per environment.
- **Output format pipeline** — `MERCURY_FORMAT` env var + `--format` flag control output rendering (auto/json/jsonl/pretty/raw/yaml/explore). `--transform` applies GJSON expressions. New output formats can be added via `OutputFormats` in `pkg/cmd/cmdutil.go`.
- **`overrides.go` (`pkg/cmd/overrides.go`)** — This is a human-authored file that survives Stainless codegen runs. It patches Usage strings and command structure after the generated `cmd.go` is loaded. If you need to adjust CLI descriptions, flatten command trees, or override flag defaults, do it here rather than editing generated files. Use `setFlagUsage()` for flag text overrides.
- **`pkg/cmd/cmdutil_unix.go` / `pkg/cmd/cmdutil_windows.go`** — Platform-specific behavior lives in these build-tagged files. New platform-specific logic (e.g., pager detection, terminal handling) should go here.

If no seam exists but one *should*, consider opening a T1 PR upstream that adds the extension point, then implementing your feature against it.

## 2. Minimal diff principle

Every patch is the **smallest change that achieves the stated goal**:

- No reformatting of existing code.
- No import reordering unless your change requires a new import.
- No whitespace-only changes.
- No "while I'm here" refactors — open a separate T1 PR.
- No dependency upgrades bundled with feature work (`go.mod`/`go.sum` changes must be scoped to the patch).
- No test framework changes bundled with feature work.

## 3. Modularity / isolation

When Rosenblatt-specific code must land in this fork:

- **Prefer new `.go` files in `pkg/cmd/` or `internal/`** over editing existing ones. This Go project uses package-level scope, so a new file in the same package automatically has access to unexported symbols.
- When you must edit an existing file, change the minimum surface and delegate to a new file. Pattern: one function call that dispatches into a new module.
- **Avoid editing generated files** (`pkg/cmd/cmd.go`, most `pkg/cmd/*.go` — anything with `// File generated from our OpenAPI spec by Stainless` at the top). Stainless regenerates these. Put overrides in `pkg/cmd/overrides.go` instead.

## 4. Match upstream conventions

- **Go 1.25**, standard library layout — `cmd/mercury/main.go` (entry point), `pkg/cmd/` (CLI commands), `internal/` (private packages).
- **Formatter:** `gofmt -s -w .` (run `scripts/format`).
- **Lint:** `go build ./...` (run `scripts/lint`). No `go vet`, `staticcheck`, or `golangci-lint` is enforced in CI.
- **Tests:** `go test ./...` with `github.com/stretchr/testify`. Test files use `*_test.go` alongside the source in the same package. Run `scripts/test`.
- **Dependencies:** Managed via `go.mod`/`go.sum`. The CLI is a thin wrapper around `github.com/MercuryTechnologies/mercury-go` (the Go SDK) using `github.com/urfave/cli/v3` for the command framework.
- **CI:** GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) runs `lint`, `build` (via goreleaser snapshot), and `test` on push/PR. The build uses `goreleaser` for multi-platform releases.

## 5. Make patches conspicuous

Every Rosenblatt patch must be trivially identifiable:

- **Commit prefix:** Every Rosenblatt-only commit uses `[rosenblatt]` as the prefix.
- **Code markers:** For non-trivial patches, add sentinel comments:
  ```go
  // === ROSENBLATT PATCH START: short description ===
  // Reason: why this patch exists
  // Upstream: link or "internal-only"
  ...patched code...
  // === ROSENBLATT PATCH END ===
  ```
- For one-line edits, an inline `// ROSENBLATT: <reason>` is sufficient.

## This fork

### Extension points

| Mechanism | Location | How to use |
|---|---|---|
| API key injection | `MERCURY_API_KEY` env var, read in `pkg/cmd/cmd.go` | Takes precedence over OAuth. Set from harness for CI/non-interactive use. |
| Base URL override | `MERCURY_BASE_URL` env var, read in `cmd/mercury/main.go` | Redirect API traffic to proxies or mock servers. |
| Environment selection | `--environment` flag (production/sandbox) | Scopes auth and endpoints per environment. |
| Output format extensibility | `OutputFormats` slice in `pkg/cmd/cmdutil.go` | Add new format names here; implement rendering in `cmdutil.go`. |
| GJSON transforms | `--transform` / `--transform-error` flags | Post-process JSON output without touching rendering code. |
| Command overrides | `pkg/cmd/overrides.go` (human-authored, survives codegen) | Override Usage strings, flatten command trees, adjust flag defaults. Use `setFlagUsage()` helper. |
| Platform-specific logic | `pkg/cmd/cmdutil_unix.go` + `cmdutil_windows.go` | Build-tagged files for OS-specific behavior (pager, terminal, color). |
| Auth storage | `internal/auth/credentials.go` — system keyring with `~/.config/mercury/credentials.json` fallback | Token storage is self-contained; add new auth methods here. |
| OAuth callback | `internal/auth/callback_render.go` — embedded HTML templates | Customize browser-based login UX. |
| Update checker | `internal/updatecheck/` — background goroutine in `cmd/mercury/main.go` | Version check against GitHub releases. Configurable via `updatecheck.Options`. |

### Style and tooling

- **Go 1.25.** Formatted with `gofmt -s -w .` (run `scripts/format`). Lint is `go build ./...` only (run `scripts/lint`). No `go vet`, `staticcheck`, or `golangci-lint` in CI. Tests use `go test ./...` with `github.com/stretchr/testify`; run `scripts/test`. Third-party dependencies are minimal — `cli/v3` for commands, `mercury-go` for the API, `gjson` for transforms, `charmbracelet/lipgloss` + `bubbletea` for TUI components, and `go-keyring` for credential storage.

### File layout

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `cmd/mercury/main.go` | Entry point. Sets up update checker, base URL override, autocomplete, error formatting. |
| `pkg/cmd/cmd.go` | **Generated.** Root command definition, all subcommands, global flags. Do not edit. |
| `pkg/cmd/overrides.go` | **Human-authored.** Post-generation overrides for Usage strings, command structure, flag descriptions. Edits here survive codegen. |
| `pkg/cmd/<resource>.go` | **Generated.** One file per API resource (accounts, payments, transactions, etc.). |
| `pkg/cmd/cmdutil.go` | Output rendering (JSON, YAML, pretty, explore), pager, terminal detection, HTTP client setup. |
| `internal/auth/` | OAuth flow, token persistence (keyring + file fallback), callback HTTP server with templates. |
| `internal/requestflag/` | Custom `cli.Flag` implementation supporting env var sources and request body binding. |
| `internal/updatecheck/` | Background version checker that queries GitHub releases. |
| `internal/jsonview/` | Interactive TUI JSON explorer (`explore` format). |

### High-churn paths to avoid

These files change most frequently in upstream releases. Avoid patching unless absolutely necessary. Prefer extension points instead.

| File | Why avoid |
|---|---|
| `pkg/cmd/cmd.go` | **Generated.** Regenerated on every Stainless codegen run. Any patch will be clobbered. Use `overrides.go`. |
| `pkg/cmd/version.go` | Bumps with every release. Only contains version constant. |
| `pkg/cmd/transaction.go` | High-activity resource command. Patches here conflict with frequent API surface updates. |
| `go.mod` / `go.sum` | Dependency bumps in every release. Bundle any required dependency changes tightly with your patch. |

### Public API surface

- The `pkg/cmd` package exports `Command` (the root `*cli.Command`) and rendering utilities (`ShowJSON`, `OutputFormats`, `Environments`). These are safe to depend on.
- `internal/` packages have no stability guarantee. Depend on their behavior only through the CLI's documented flags and env vars.
- Generated files are marked with `// File generated from our OpenAPI spec by Stainless` at the top. Do not edit them.

## Commit prefix

Every Rosenblatt-only commit in this fork uses `[rosenblatt]` as the prefix.
